schema_note: A conformance fixture, not a recording. It exists to prove that app/static/trace.js is driven by the schema and not by the one run that happens to be in this folder: it uses different agent names, different tool names, a different depth of nesting, explicit start_ms offsets instead of derived ones, and a span field the viewer has never seen. If the viewer renders this file correctly without an edit, then a live orchestrator emitting eazli.agent-trace/v1 tomorrow will render too.
provenance: SYNTHETIC. Nothing here happened. No agent was invoked, no tool was called, and every value below was written by hand to exercise a branch of the viewer. It is evidence about the viewer, not about the system. The real recording in this folder is the one that carries provenance: REAL.
